Everything a food business needs, in one place

From the page people find on Google to the screen in your kitchen. Start free, add the paid modules when you need them.

Get found

{% icon "search" "h-5 w-5" %}

A page Google can find

Your own page with your menu, prices, photos, opening hours and location. Built to rank for searches like restaurants in Westlands and your name plus menu.

{% icon "menu" "h-5 w-5" %}

Menu with real prices

Add dishes by menu type, with photos and VAT handled either way. Dishes without a fixed price show as price on request and customers ask for a quote.

{% icon "star" "h-5 w-5" %}

Verified reviews

Every review is confirmed by email before it shows, one per customer. You reply from your dashboard and the rating shows on your page and in search.

{% icon "tag" "h-5 w-5" %}

Special offers

Happy hours, combos and discounts with start and end dates. They appear on your page and, for Premium listings, on the public Deals page.

{% icon "chat" "h-5 w-5" %}

Questions answered on your page

A chat button answers the usual questions from your own listing: are you open, where are you, how much is the pilau, do you deliver. Anything else goes to WhatsApp.

{% icon "inbox" "h-5 w-5" %}

Inquiries and bookings

Visitors pick from your menu and send an inquiry with their name, phone and delivery area. Table bookings and quote requests land in the same inbox.

Take orders in the restaurant

{% icon "qr" "h-5 w-5" %}

QR menu that only works at your tables

Each business gets a private QR link. Customers scan it, pick their dishes and order from their phone. Nobody outside the room can use it, and you can replace the link at any time.

{% icon "id" "h-5 w-5" %}

Waiter codes

Every waiter has a five digit code. The customer types it at checkout and the order goes straight to that waiter, the same way a paper slip would. The receipt shows who served them.

{% icon "chef" "h-5 w-5" %}

Kitchen screen

A cooking screen for a tablet by the pass. New orders arrive in red, the kitchen taps start and then ready, and the waiter is told the moment food is up.

{% icon "table" "h-5 w-5" %}

Tables and live order status

Orders are attached to a table and a waiter. Your orders page updates on its own every ten seconds, so the counter, the floor and the kitchen all see the same thing.

{% icon "clipboard" "h-5 w-5" %}

Order tracking and receipts

Every order has a tracking page the customer can watch from received to served. Once paid, they can view or download their receipt without asking anyone.

{% icon "whatsapp" "h-5 w-5" %}

WhatsApp when it helps

Customers can send you their order or inquiry on WhatsApp in one tap, with everything already written. No app to install, and nothing you have to pay per message.

Run the business

{% icon "pos" "h-5 w-5" %}

Point of sale

Ring up counter sales, send orders to the kitchen and take payment in cash, M-Pesa or card, with the transaction code and the payer's name on record.

{% icon "users" "h-5 w-5" %}

Staff accounts that see only their part

Waiters see their own orders. The kitchen sees what to cook. Cashiers take payments and see sales. You see everything, including who sold what.

{% icon "cash" "h-5 w-5" %}

Sales, expenses and profit

Daily, weekly and monthly sales by item, by waiter and by payment method. Log expenses and read your profit and loss without a spreadsheet.

{% icon "chart" "h-5 w-5" %}

Insights

Plain language findings from your own numbers: what sells, what is slipping, your quiet days and what to try next week. Nothing leaves your account.

{% icon "pin" "h-5 w-5" %}

Delivery zones

Tick the areas you deliver to from a list of suburbs in your county and set your own fee for each. The fee shows when someone asks for delivery.

{% icon "pin" "h-5 w-5" %}

More than one branch

Run every outlet from one account. Staff are attached to a branch and see only its work, while you switch between branches or view them all together. One menu and price list, separate tills, stock and reports. Each extra branch is paid for on its own.

{% icon "photo" "h-5 w-5" %}

Marketing kit and printable menu

A print ready poster, a WhatsApp status image and a square post with your logo and QR code, plus a branded menu PDF you can print or send.

Free to list. Pay only for what you use.

The listing, menu, inquiries and reviews are free. Premium removes the item limit and puts your offers on the Deals page. The point of sale module adds the kitchen screen, staff accounts, orders, sales and reports. Both are monthly, paid by M-Pesa, cancel any time.
